description: Phase 2R revision of the session-context-assembler shadow research lane benchmark corpus. Supersedes r0's non-binding budget protocol and source-recall measurement ceiling while preserving every r0 case's conversation content, required IDs, and notes unchanged. Illustrative, fixture-local synthetic cases - not derived from real conversations, real tenants, or real Engrams. Not measured benchmark results; this file defines inputs and expected-recall labels only.
promotion_rule: Use only to evaluate Phase 3 baselines (A: full history, B: naive sliding window, C: governed episode-selected context) under docs/session_context_assembler_spec.md Phase 4 gates. Passing this corpus does not authorize production integration, Engram writes, retrieval-ranking changes, or governance/authority mutation. See docs/adr/0007-session-context-assembler-shadow-only.md.
id_namespace_note: All session_id, task_id, decision_id, source_id, and engram_id values use the SCA-R0/SCA-R1 fixture namespace and are not references to any real MNEMOS artifact.
revision_note: r0 (benchmarks/truthsets/session_context_assembler_r0.json) remains frozen and unmodified. Every r0 case is carried into r1 with unchanged turn text, required IDs, irrelevant-turn labels, family, and notes. R1 recalculates expected_context_budget, adds explicit expected_contradiction_status labels, and adds structured linked_source_ids wherever a required source was previously metadata-only (see docs/session_context_assembler_corpus_design_r1.md). Five new cases (sca_r1_pad_004..006, sca_r1_caf_004, sca_r1_urd_004) address decision-artifact-retention stress and structured source-link recoverability gaps identified in docs/session_context_assembler_phase_3_notes.md.
